title: iframes & new tabs
summary: Pay inside the 'Payment form' iframe, then follow a link that opens the help center in a new tab.
why: Payment widgets and help links are everyday features that need special handling: elements inside an iframe are invisible to page-level locators, and a new tab is a new Page object you must capture.
objectives: Reach the iframe with page.getByTitle('Payment form').contentFrame()
Pay with 4242 4242 4242 4242 and assert the confirmation inside the frame
Capture the new tab with page.waitForEvent('popup') started before the click
hints: const popupPromise = page.waitForEvent('popup'); await link.click(); const help = await popupPromise;
Assertions on the new tab use the new page: expect(help.getByRole('heading', …))
pitfalls: Locating the card field on page instead of the frame → 'element not found'.
Awaiting the click before starting waitForEvent — the popup can be missed.
teachAlong: Cause: the iframe is a separate document.
Effect: you locate inside it via contentFrame().
Gate: planted bugs decline the card and break the help page heading.

requires.reason: Elements inside an iframe need a frame locator: page.getByTitle('Payment form').contentFrame().
Capture the new tab with const popup = page.waitForEvent('popup') before clicking the link.
